title: Vehicle storage establishments
previewText: Within Subdistrict G, commercial or public vehicle storage, including accessory motor fuel pumps listed under Use Group IX(C) shall be permitted as-of-right, applicable to a C8 District. The floor area of a building shall not include floor space used for public utility vehicle storage provided in any story located not more than 56 feet above curb level.
